rules.qualified_support: Phase 3 positive evidence plus supportive ETF-level/core horizon/time evidence, no direction reversal, no major sample or concentration warning.
rules.conditional_support: Positive direction remains, but robustness is partial or confidence is capped by concentration, limited sample, weak excess, or sample dependence.
rules.descriptive_only: Label remains useful only as description, not future score-adjustment research input.
rules.unstable: Direction reversal or core instability prevents use in future adjusted preview research.
rules.qualified_conflict: Phase 3 conflict evidence plus negative ETF-level/core horizon evidence without major caveats.
rules.insufficient: Effective samples or Phase 3 cell evidence are insufficient.
